title: Family donates 47 acres to expand Audra State Park
summary_full: In a heartfelt gesture, a West Virginia family has gifted 47 acres to Audra State Park, commemorating the legacy of Victor Thacker’s great-great-grandparents, Jacob and Sarah Thacker. This donation enriches the park's landscape and opens up new opportunities for future trail development. Park officials conveyed their sincere appreciation for this contribution that enhances the region's natural heritage, providing visitors with even more space to explore and enjoy.
